enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Shift legs. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and personal hygiene (showering, brushing teeth)
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up and sit up. Stand and walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower and adjust water. Step into shower. Wash body and rinse. Turn off shower. Step out and dry with towel. Brush teeth and rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Crack eggs into bowl and whisk. Turn on stove. Pour oil and eggs into pan. Cook and stir. Turn off stove. Plate eggs. Sit and eat. Drink milk. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Take out clothes from wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Put on jacket. Pick up keys. Open door. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward. Start shift.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Review patient charts. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Assist with mobility. Change dressings. Insert IV. Monitor patients. Respond to call lights. Communicate with doctors. Document care. Assist with meals. Transfer patients. Clean equipment. Sterilize instruments. Attend briefing. Update records.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Take off shoes. Hang up jacket. Walk to living room.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator and take out vegetables and meat. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash vegetables and chop. Cut meat. Turn on stove and pour oil into pan. Add meat and stir. Add vegetables and stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove and place food on plate. Sit at table and eat. Drink water. Wash dishes. Walk to living room.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up drink. Drink. Put down drink. Lean back. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal time using computer and phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open web browser and browse news. Open social media. Scroll feed. Open phone. Check messages. Reply to messages. Watch video on computer. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Turn off computer. Turn off phone. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Shift legs. Sleep.
